blocks.text: O'zbekchada «qaysi», «qanaqa», «qanday» so'zlari ko'pincha o'rin almashib ishlatiladi. Ingliz tilida **what** va **which** ning farqi aniq: **what + ot** — tanlov keng, variantlar oldindan ma'lum emas: **What** colour is your car? (har qanday rang bo'lishi mumkin). **which + ot** — tanlov cheklangan, variantlar ko'z oldida yoki gapda aytilgan: **Which** colour do you prefer, red or blue? (faqat ikki variant).

O'zingizdan so'rang: «Javob bir nechta ma'lum variantdan biri bo'ladimi?» Ha bo'lsa — **which**, yo'q bo'lsa — **what**. Shuning uchun «Eng sevimli taomingiz qaysi?» inglizchada **What**'s your favourite dish? — dunyodagi har qanday taom bo'lishi mumkin. «Choy yoki qahva — qaysi biri?» esa **Which** do you want, tea or coffee?

rows: **What** kind of music do you like?
**Which** bus goes to the airport — 15 or 22?
Qaysi biri arzonroq, bumi yoki u?

items.text: Brown or black — **which** shoes go with this suit?
items.translation: Jigarrangmi yoki qora — bu kostyumga **qaysi** tufli mos keladi?

blocks.text: Otsiz ishlatilganda: **what** — umumiy savol (What do you need?), **which** — odatda **which one / which ones** yoki **which of** + ko'plik bilan: **Which one** do you want? **Which of** these bags is yours? (→ 75-dars). Odamlar haqida: ot bilan — **which** (Which teacher?), otsiz — **who** (**Who** is your teacher?). «Who of you» deyilmaydi — **Which of** you ...?

items.text: **Which** doctor did you see, Dr Brown or Dr Karimova?
items.translation: **Qaysi** shifokorga ko'rindingiz — doktor Braungami yoki doktor Karimovagami?

blocks.text: O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «Which is your name?» → **What's your name?**; «What is better, tea or coffee?» → **Which is better, tea or coffee?** (ikki variant); «Who of you is Aziz?» → **Which of you is Aziz?**; «What is the capital of Scotland?» — to'g'ri (o'zbekchada «qaysi shahar», inglizchada **what**).

O'zbek tilida o'lchov va miqdor uchun alohida savol so'zlari bor: «**necha** yoshda?», «**qancha** uzoq?», «**qanchalik** tez-tez?», «**nechta**?». Ingliz tilida ularning ko'pi bitta qolip bilan yasaladi: **How + sifat / ravish**. How **old**? — necha yoshda? How **far**? — qancha uzoq? How **often**? — qanchalik tez-tez? Bu birikma bir butun savol so'zi kabi gap boshida turadi, keyin odatiy savol tartibi: How old **is she**? How often **do you** go there?

rows: How many sisters have you got?
How well do you speak Russian?

items.text: **How old** is this building? — About five hundred years old.
items.translation: Bu bino **necha yillik**? — Taxminan besh yuz yillik.

items.text: **How many** rooms are there in the hotel?
**How often** does the bus come? — Every twenty minutes.
items.translation: Avtobus **qanchalik tez-tez** keladi? — Har yigirma daqiqada.

blocks.text: **How many** — sanaladigan ot bilan (how many **apples**, how many **people**), **how much** — sanalmaydigan ot bilan (how much **water**, how much **money**) va narx so'raganda: How much **is** it? / How much **does** it **cost**? (→ 83-dars). **How long** — vaqt («qancha vaqt?») yoki uzunlik; masofa uchun esa **how far**. Vaqt sarfi haqidagi How long does it take ...? — → 48-dars.

Tipik xatolar: «How much years?» → **How many years?**; «How many money?» → **How much money?**; «How old are you? — I have 25.» → **I'm 25.**; «How long is it to Samarkand?» (masofa) → **How far is it to Samarkand?**; «How is the price?» → **How much is it?**

Eslab qolish: **what** — «ochiq» savol, **which** — «menyudan tanlash». **How + so'z** — o'zbekcha «qancha / necha / qanchalik» ning inglizcha kaliti: o'lchovning nomini toping (old, far, long, often, much) va oldiga **how** qo'ying.
Bog'liq darslar: savolda so'z tartibi — → 44-dars; which / how many ega bo'lganda (Which bus goes ...?) — → 45-dars; which one / which ones — → 75-dars; much / many — → 83-dars.

items: **What + ot** — tanlov keng: What colour? What time? What kind of ...?
**Which + ot** — tanlov cheklangan, variantlar ma'lum: Which bus? Which one? Which of these?
Odamlar: ot bilan — **which** (which student?), otsiz — **who** (who is she?).
**How + sifat / ravish**: how old, how tall, how far, how long, how often, how well.
**How many** + sanaladigan, **how much** + sanalmaydigan va narx.

examples.title: **What** + noun: colour, time, kind
examples.description: **What + ot** — variantlar ko'p va oldindan ma'lum emas: What **colour**? What **time**? What **kind of**? What **size**? O'zbekchada «qanaqa», «qanday», «qaysi», «soat nechada».

sentences.text: **What colour** is your new car? — Dark blue.
sentences.translation: Yangi mashinangiz **qanaqa rangda**? — To'q ko'k.

sentences.text: On Saturdays, **what time** does the museum close?
sentences.translation: Shanba kunlari muzey **soat nechada** yopiladi?

sentences.text: **What kind** of films do you like?
sentences.translation: **Qanaqa** filmlarni yoqtirasiz?

sentences.text: **What size** are these shoes? — Forty-two.
sentences.translation: Bu tufli **nechanchi o'lcham**? — Qirq ikki.

sentences.text: Excuse me, **what day** is the market open?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bozor **qaysi kuni** ochiq?

sentences.text: Your sister works as a translator. **What languages** does she speak?
sentences.translation: Opangiz tarjimon bo'lib ishlaydi. U **qaysi tillarda** gapiradi?

sentences.text: Tom has bought a new phone. **What model** did he choose?
sentences.translation: Tom yangi telefon sotib oldi. U **qanaqa model** tanladi?

sentences.text: In your country, **what sports** are popular?
sentences.translation: Mamlakatingizda **qanday sport turlari** ommabop?

sentences.text: I've never met Madina's husband. **What job** does he do?
sentences.translation: Madinaning eri bilan hech tanishmaganman. U **qanaqa ish** qiladi?

sentences.text: At the wedding, **what music** did they play? — Uzbek songs, mostly.
sentences.translation: To'yda **qanaqa musiqa** chalishdi? — Asosan o'zbek qo'shiqlari.

examples.title: **Which** + noun: choosing from a few
examples.description: **Which** — tanlov cheklangan: ikki-uchta ma'lum variantdan biri. Ko'pincha variantlar gapda aytiladi (left or right?) yoki ko'z oldida turadi.

sentences.text: There are two buses. **Which** bus goes to the airport?
sentences.translation: Ikkita avtobus bor. Aeroportga **qaysi** biri boradi?

sentences.text: **Which** hand do you write with, left or right?
sentences.translation: **Qaysi** qo'lingiz bilan yozasiz — chapmi yoki o'ngmi?

sentences.text: We have tea or coffee. **Which** would you prefer?
sentences.translation: Choy yoki qahva bor. **Qaysi** birini afzal ko'rasiz?

sentences.text: **Which** way is the station — left or right?
sentences.translation: Vokzal **qaysi** tomonda — chapdami yoki o'ngdami?

sentences.text: Bekzod has three brothers. **Which** one is the oldest?
sentences.translation: Bekzodning uchta aka-ukasi bor. **Qaysi** biri eng kattasi?

sentences.text: There are two Sarahs in our class. **Which** Sarah do you mean?
sentences.translation: Sinfimizda ikkita Sara bor. **Qaysi** Sarani nazarda tutyapsiz?

sentences.text: **Which** room is yours, the one on the left?
sentences.translation: **Qaysi** xona sizniki — chapdagisimi?

sentences.text: You can sit by the window or near the door. **Which** seat do you want?
sentences.translation: Deraza yonida yoki eshik yaqinida o'tirishingiz mumkin. **Qaysi** joyni xohlaysiz?

sentences.text: I've got a red dress and a green one. **Which** looks better on me?
sentences.translation: Qizil va yashil ko'ylagim bor. **Qaysi** biri menga ko'proq yarashadi?

sentences.text: Look at these photos. **Which** one shall we send to Grandma?
sentences.translation: Bu suratlarga qarang. **Qaysi** birini buvimga yuboramiz?

examples.title: **What** or **which**?
examples.description: Juft savollar: **What** sport do you play? (har qanday sport) — **Which** sport do you prefer, tennis or football? (ikki variant). O'zbekchada ikkalasi ham «qaysi» bo'lishi mumkin.

sentences.text: **What** sport do you play? — Volleyball.
sentences.translation: **Qanaqa** sport bilan shug'ullanasiz? — Voleybol.

sentences.text: Tennis or football — **which** sport do you prefer?
sentences.translation: Tennis yoki futbol — **qaysi** birini afzal ko'rasiz?

sentences.text: Your garden is beautiful. **What** flowers do you grow?
sentences.translation: Bog'ingiz juda chiroyli. **Qanday** gullar o'stirasiz?

sentences.text: These roses are lovely. **Which** ones should I buy, the red or the white?
sentences.translation: Bu atirgullar juda chiroyli. **Qaysi**larini olay — qizilnimi yoki oqnimi?

sentences.text: **What** is the capital of Scotland? — Edinburgh.
sentences.translation: Shotlandiyaning poytaxti **qaysi** shahar? — Edinburg.

sentences.text: Samarkand or Bukhara: **which** city is older?
sentences.translation: Samarqand yoki Buxoro — **qaysi** shahar qadimiyroq?

sentences.text: **What**'s your favourite dish? — Plov, of course!
sentences.translation: Eng sevimli taomingiz **qaysi**? — Albatta, palov!

sentences.text: There are four flavours. **Which** do you want?
sentences.translation: To'rt xil ta'm bor. **Qaysi** birini xohlaysiz?

sentences.text: At university, **what** subjects did you study?
sentences.translation: Universitetda **qanday** fanlarni o'qigansiz?

sentences.text: Maths or history — **which** subject was easier for you at school?
sentences.translation: Matematika yoki tarix — maktabda **qaysi** fan sizga osonroq edi?

examples.title: **Which one?** **Which of** ...? **Who** or **which**?
examples.description: Ot takrorlanmasa — **which one / which ones**; **which of** + ko'plik: which of you, which of them. Odamlar haqida: ot bilan — **which** (which teacher), otsiz — **who**.

sentences.text: I like both jackets. — **Which one** are you going to buy?
sentences.translation: Ikkala kurtka ham yoqadi. — **Qaysi birini** olmoqchisiz?

sentences.text: **Which of** you can speak Russian? I need some help.
sentences.translation: **Qaysi biringiz** ruscha gapira olasiz? Menga yordam kerak.

sentences.text: **Who** is your favourite singer?
sentences.translation: Sevimli qo'shiqchingiz **kim**?

sentences.text: **Which** teacher do you like most, Mr Brown or Ms Karimova?
sentences.translation: **Qaysi** o'qituvchini ko'proq yoqtirasiz — janob Braunnimi yoki Karimova xonimnimi?

sentences.text: These two phones look the same. **Which is** cheaper?
sentences.translation: Bu ikki telefon bir xil ko'rinadi. **Qaysi biri** arzonroq?

sentences.text: There are lots of shoes here. **Which ones** are yours?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda poyabzal ko'p. **Qaysilari** sizniki?

sentences.text: **Who** won the last World Cup?
sentences.translation: Oxirgi jahon chempionatida **kim** g'olib bo'ldi?

sentences.text: Aziz has two sisters. **Which of** them lives in London?
sentences.translation: Azizning ikki singlisi bor. Ularning **qaysi biri** Londonda yashaydi?

sentences.text: **Which** student got the highest mark in the test?
sentences.translation: Testda **qaysi** talaba eng yuqori baho oldi?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **which** platform does the Manchester train leave from?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, Manchester poyezdi **qaysi** platformadan jo'naydi?

examples.title: **How old**, **How tall**, **How big**: age and size
examples.description: Yosh va o'lcham: **How old** (necha yoshda), **How tall / high** (bo'yi, balandligi), **How big**, **How heavy**, **How deep**, **How wide**, **How long** (uzunligi).

sentences.text: **How old** is your grandfather? — He's eighty-two.
sentences.translation: Bobongiz **necha yoshda**? — Sakson ikkida.

sentences.text: **How tall** are you? — About one metre seventy-five.
sentences.translation: **Bo'yingiz qancha**? — Taxminan bir metr yetmish besh.

sentences.text: So you've moved! **How big** is your new flat?
sentences.translation: Demak, ko'chib o'tdingiz! Yangi kvartirangiz **qanchalik katta**?

sentences.text: Your suitcase looks heavy. **How heavy** is it?
sentences.translation: Chamadoningiz og'ir ko'rinadi. **Qancha** tortadi?

sentences.text: The lake is beautiful. **How deep** is it here?
sentences.translation: Ko'l juda chiroyli. Bu yerda **qanchalik chuqur**?

sentences.text: In Uzbekistan, **how high** is the highest mountain?
sentences.translation: O'zbekistondagi eng baland tog' **qanchalik baland**?

sentences.text: Bekzod's son is very tall now. **How old** is he?
sentences.translation: Bekzodning o'g'li endi juda baland bo'yli. U **necha yoshda**?

sentences.text: Before we buy the sofa, **how wide** is the door?
sentences.translation: Divanni olishdan oldin bilaylik: eshikning **eni qancha**?

sentences.text: **How long** is the river Thames?
sentences.translation: Temza daryosining **uzunligi qancha**?

sentences.text: In Tashkent, **how hot** does it get in July?
sentences.translation: Toshkentda iyulda havo **qanchalik isiydi**?

examples.title: **How far**, **How long**, **How often**
examples.description: Masofa — **How far**, vaqt — **How long**, takrorlanish — **How often**, daraja va tezlik — **How well**, **How fast**, **How soon**.

sentences.text: **How far** is it from Tashkent to Samarkand? — About three hundred kilometres.
sentences.translation: Toshkentdan Samarqandgacha **qancha masofa**? — Taxminan uch yuz kilometr.

sentences.text: **How long** have you been learning English?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilini **qancha vaqtdan beri** o'rganyapsiz?

sentences.text: **How often** do you go to the gym? — Three times a week.
sentences.translation: Sport zaliga **qanchalik tez-tez** borasiz? — Haftada uch marta.

sentences.text: Your English is very good. **How well** does your brother speak it?
sentences.translation: Ingliz tilingiz juda yaxshi. Akangiz uni **qanchalik yaxshi** biladi?

sentences.text: The station isn't far. — Really? **How far** is it?
sentences.translation: Vokzal uzoq emas. — Rostdanmi? **Qancha** uzoqlikda?

sentences.text: This car is very powerful. **How fast** can it go?
sentences.translation: Bu mashina juda kuchli. U **qanchalik tez** yura oladi?

sentences.text: When you lived in London, **how often** did you visit your family?
sentences.translation: Londonda yashaganingizda oilangiznikiga **qanchalik tez-tez** borardingiz?

sentences.text: Sorry I missed it. **How long** did the meeting last?
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qatnasha olmadim. Yig'ilish **qancha davom etdi**?

sentences.text: Madina's son is learning to swim. **How well** can he swim now?
sentences.translation: Madinaning o'g'li suzishni o'rganyapti. U hozir **qanchalik yaxshi** suza oladi?

sentences.text: I'm going to the airport. **How soon** will the taxi be here?
sentences.translation: Aeroportga ketyapman. Taksi **qancha vaqtda** yetib keladi?

examples.title: **How much** and **How many**
examples.description: **How many** + sanaladigan ot (ko'plik): «nechta?». **How much** + sanalmaydigan ot: «qancha?»; narx haqida ham: How much **is** it? — «Qancha turadi?»

sentences.text: **How many** children have Aziz and Dilnoza got? — Three.
sentences.translation: Aziz bilan Dilnozaning **nechta** farzandi bor? — Uchta.

sentences.text: **How much** sugar do you take in your tea?
sentences.translation: Choyingizga **qancha** shakar solasiz?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **how much** are these apples? — Two pounds a kilo.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, bu olmalar **qancha** turadi? — Kilosi ikki funt.

sentences.text: Tashkent is a big city. **How many** people live there?
sentences.translation: Toshkent katta shahar. U yerda **qancha** odam yashaydi?

sentences.text: For the party, **how much** food should we buy?
sentences.translation: Ziyofat uchun **qancha** ovqat olishimiz kerak?

sentences.text: You speak so many languages! **How many** do you know?
sentences.translation: Juda ko'p tilda gapirasiz! **Nechta** tilni bilasiz?

sentences.text: **How much** did you pay for your ticket to London?
sentences.translation: Londonga chiptangiz uchun **qancha** to'ladingiz?

sentences.text: There's a lot of homework. — **How many** exercises do we have to do?
sentences.translation: Uy vazifasi ko'p. — **Nechta** mashq qilishimiz kerak?

sentences.text: Tom drinks a lot of coffee. **How many** cups does he have a day?
sentences.translation: Tom ko'p qahva ichadi. U kuniga **necha** finjon ichadi?

sentences.text: I want to rent a flat in the centre. **How much** does it cost a month?
sentences.translation: Markazdan kvartira ijaraga olmoqchiman. Bir oyiga **qancha** turadi?

examples.title: Dialogue: renting a flat in Manchester
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: telefon orqali kvartira haqida so'rash — **what**, **which** va **how** bilan turli savollar.

sentences.text: — Hello, I'm calling about the flat. **How much** is the rent?
sentences.translation: — Assalomu alaykum, kvartira bo'yicha qo'ng'iroq qilyapman. Ijara **qancha**?

sentences.text: — Eight hundred pounds a month. **Which** flat do you mean — the one on King Street?
sentences.translation: — Oyiga sakkiz yuz funt. **Qaysi** kvartirani nazarda tutyapsiz — King ko'chasidagisinimi?

sentences.text: — Yes, that one. **How big** is it?
sentences.translation: — Ha, o'shani. U **qanchalik katta**?

sentences.text: — It's got two bedrooms and a small kitchen. **What** else would you like to know?
sentences.translation: — Ikkita yotoqxonasi va kichkina oshxonasi bor. Yana **nimani** bilmoqchisiz?

sentences.text: — **How far** is it from the university?
sentences.translation: — Universitetdan **qancha uzoqlikda**?

sentences.text: — About fifteen minutes by bus. **How many** people will live there?
sentences.translation: — Avtobusda o'n besh daqiqacha. U yerda **necha** kishi yashaydi?

sentences.text: — Just me and my friend Bekzod. **What floor** is it on?
sentences.translation: — Faqat men va do'stim Bekzod. U **nechanchi qavatda**?

sentences.text: — The third. **What time** can you come and see it?
sentences.translation: — Uchinchida. Ko'rgani **soat nechada** kela olasiz?

sentences.text: — Tomorrow at five. **How often** do the buses run in the evening?
sentences.translation: — Ertaga soat beshda. Kechqurun avtobuslar **qanchalik tez-tez** yuradi?

sentences.text: — **Every ten minutes**, so it's very convenient. See you tomorrow!
sentences.translation: — **Har o'n daqiqada**, shuning uchun juda qulay. Ertaga ko'rishguncha!
